Title: Membrane permeability of fluorescent probes
Description: Calculates a lipophilicity value tuned for fluorescent probes, whose charged and highly conjugated scaffolds fall outside the chemistry most logP predictors were fitted on. Soliman and colleagues trained DeepFl-LogP specifically on dye-like molecules, since knowing whether a probe crosses the cell membrane determines whether it can be used for live-cell imaging at all. Values above 1 generally indicate a membrane-permeant probe, though permeability also depends on charge state and size.
Interpretation: Calculated octanol-water partition coefficient, where values above 1 suggest membrane permeability.
